reason: The price is fine for me and the house does need it after the monsoon, but 'finishes by the agreed date' is what every painter promises, and nothing says what happens if they don't. I'm in Dubai, so if the crew vanishes halfway it's my elderly parents left chasing them with the house half done.
objection: There's a guarantee on peeling and bubbling, but no penalty or refund if they miss the finish date, and no word on who my parents or I can call when the crew doesn't show up.
would_change_my_mind: A written per-day compensation if they finish late, plus one named coordinator who sends me daily photo updates on WhatsApp so my parents don't have to supervise.
